lines.text: Moses sent messengers from the Wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon with an offer of peace, promising to pay silver for food and water.
Sihon refused to let Israel pass, because the LORD had made his spirit stubborn, and his army came out against Israel at Hazor.
Israel captured all of Sihon's cities and carried off only the livestock and the plunder for themselves.
Og king of Bashan came out with his whole army to fight Israel at Edrei, and the LORD delivered him over.
Israel captured all sixty of Og's cities and took the land across the Jordan from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Carmel.
